name: MODP_ADDONLY
description: Minimal single-operation spec: the classic grokking setup (Power et al. 2022 / Nanda et al. 2023-style mod-addition table), reduced from the full MODP complex to only P=(a,b), S=a+b and the placebo control vertex X. One taught edge P_S (addition), one placebo edge P_X, no faces. Intended to be paired with run_grok.py/queue_grok.py's --preset classic (1 layer, full-batch AdamW, wd=1.0, 50000 steps) -- the setting the grokking literature actually uses -- as a fast, cheap, minimal-confound reference point before spending GPU time on the full 13-edge/3-face MODP complex. Uses vertex_present_mode=blanket: with only 3 vertices, whether the control vertex X is connected (via P_X) or isolated is itself the quantity of interest, not a nuisance to be hidden (contrast with MODP, where X is one of 11 vertices and the placebo-invariance guarantee is closure-driven instead -- see README).
